typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and flat, unbracketed serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was prevalent in French academic and scientific printing during the 19th century.
